Import an asset into a Blender scene

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli asset import --asset model.glb --output scene.blend [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli asset import --asset model.glb --output scene.blend --collection "Imported CAD" --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli asset import --asset part.stl --output part.blend

Flags:
      --asset string        Asset to import (.glb, .gltf, .obj, .fbx, .stl)
      --collection string   Collection name for imported objects (default "Imported CAD")
      --dry-run             Print the command without running Blender
  -h, --help                help for import
      --output string       Output .blend path
      --timeout duration    Maximum runtime (default 10m0s)

Check CLI health

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli doctor [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli doctor

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for doctor

blender-pp-cli doctor
  go: go1.26.3
  os: linux/amd64
  blender: /mnt/c/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.1/blender.exe
  blender-mcp: /home/markimus/.local/bin/blender-mcp
  status: ok

Create a reproducible Blender job manifest

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli handoff plan --asset model.glb [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli handoff plan --asset exports/assembly.glb --mode turntable --frames 120
  blender-pp-cli handoff plan --asset onshape-export.json --output-blend assembly.blend --write blender-job.json

Flags:
      --asset string          Source asset path, export manifest, or Onshape-derived file
      --engine string         Render engine (default "BLENDER_EEVEE")
      --frames int            Turntable frame count (default 120)
  -h, --help                  help for plan
      --mode string           Planned workflow: still or turntable (default "still")
      --output-blend string   Planned .blend output path
      --write string          Optional path to write the manifest JSON

Start blender-mcp for tandem/live sessions

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli mcp serve [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli mcp serve --transport stdio --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli mcp serve --transport http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --dry-run

Flags:
      --dry-run            Print the command without running blender-mcp
  -h, --help               help for serve
      --host string        HTTP host (default "127.0.0.1")
      --port int           HTTP port (default 8000)
      --timeout duration   Maximum runtime for non-dry-run serve (default 30s)
      --transport string   Transport: stdio or http (default "stdio")

Check blender-mcp installation and optional HTTP endpoint

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli mcp status [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli mcp status
  blender-pp-cli mcp status --url http://127.0.0.1:8000/

Flags:
  -h, --help         help for status
      --url string   Optional blender-mcp HTTP URL to probe

Render a still image in background mode

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli render still --blend scene.blend --output render.png [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli render still --blend scene.blend --output render.png --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli render still --output startup.png --engine BLENDER_EEVEE --resolution 1280x720

Flags:
      --blend string        Blend file to render; omitted uses startup scene
      --dry-run             Print the command without running Blender
      --engine string       Render engine (default "BLENDER_EEVEE")
  -h, --help                help for still
      --output string       Output image path (default "render.png")
      --resolution string   Render resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT (default "1920x1080")
      --timeout duration    Maximum runtime (default 10m0s)

Create a simple turntable animation job

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli render turntable --blend scene.blend --output scene-turntable.blend [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli render turntable --blend scene.blend --output scene-turntable.blend --frames 120 --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli render turntable --output startup-turntable.blend --frames 48

Flags:
      --blend string       Blend file to animate; omitted uses startup scene
      --dry-run            Print the command without running Blender
      --engine string      Render engine (default "BLENDER_EEVEE")
      --frames int         Turntable frame count (default 120)
  -h, --help               help for turntable
      --output string      Output .blend path (default "turntable.blend")
      --timeout duration   Maximum runtime (default 10m0s)

Locate Blender and blender-mcp runtimes

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli resolve blender [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli resolve blender
  blender-pp-cli resolve blender --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for blender
      --json   Output JSON

mode: headless+tandem
blender: /mnt/c/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.1/blender.exe
blender-mcp: /home/markimus/.local/bin/blender-mcp

Inspect a Blender scene or importable asset

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli scene inspect --file scene.blend [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli scene inspect --file scene.blend --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli scene inspect --dry-run

Flags:
      --dry-run            Print the command without running Blender
      --file string        Blend file to inspect; omitted means Blender's startup scene
  -h, --help               help for inspect
      --timeout duration   Maximum runtime (default 5m0s)

Run a Python script through Blender background mode

Usage:
  blender-pp-cli script run --script job.py [flags]

Examples:
  blender-pp-cli script run --script job.py --dry-run
  blender-pp-cli script run --blend scene.blend --script job.py --arg --my-flag --json

Flags:
      --arg stringArray    Argument passed after Blender's -- separator
      --blend string       Optional .blend file to open
      --dry-run            Print the command without running Blender
  -h, --help               help for run
      --json               Output JSON
      --script string      Python script to run
      --timeout duration   Maximum runtime (default 5m0s)
